name: Cash-flow explorer
prompt: Design a full-bleed 1440px wide (landscape 3:2) desktop screenshot of real polished software, phooey! finance, a finance dashboard for a solopreneur. This revision absolutely requires compact modern sans-serif typography everywhere (Geist or similar), a restrained 24px heading, tabular numbers, a graph-led screen with a real tool strip and data density. Light warm neutral background, rich deep green ink #173C35, muted burnt-orange expense series #BD522D, jade net series. Actual user chrome, no marketing, no eyebrows or ornamental labels, no fake growth badges, no bank logos. Use existing lowercase round bold "phooey!" wordmark. Operational navigation must include Overview, Transactions, Reports, Accounts, Invoicer and Settings. Use fictional figures: period income $48,600, expenses $16,240, net $32,360. Add transaction, reporting period, currency (USD), graph style selector and a graph/table view toggle. All controls that appear must make sense. Typography should look like a meticulously typeset contemporary web app at 100% zoom. Full app viewport; no outer frame. A narrow forest-green vertical navigation sidebar, wordmark in white. On the warm near-white canvas: compact Overview header and period/currency controls. A full-width large chart region with three quietly aligned totals at the top, then a green and russet two-series line plot across months January–November. Direct legend and a restrained vertical hover cursor with a small amount tooltip. A compact segmented Line/Bars/Table control. Below, two side-by-side sections: Recent transactions as a dense table, Expenses by category as horizontal bars. Light rules and intentional margins, no floating corners on every element. This direction is about tracing monthly cash flow.
